en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a formal park with a large oval reflecting pool bordered by low stone walls and manicured shrubs. Tall poplar trees and other greenery encircle the water, and a low modern-style building stands in the background near the far edge of the pool. The reverse side has Hungarian printed text indicating the location, a handwritten message and address, and a Hungarian postage stamp.
